description:
James Falconer from The Boundary explains how the real estate industry is adopting new real-time workflows, including virtual production, and why students and recent graduates need broad, adaptable skill sets to succeed.

Learn about the emerging technologies and workflows shaping the industry, and discover how to apply real-time skills to high-end digital twin projects. 👯

Check out the full interview!: https://youtu.be/viTjFK3eYGQ
